rows.en: What'll I do… So how do we decide? Do I go with Hongo, or with Hayato?
Whichever you like…
Hey, hey… You're not going to use some coin with heads on both sides, are you?
Rescue Yoshiko and be the lone prince charming? That wouldn't be bad either, but come on, trust me…
All right, heads! …No, wait… I'll go with tails!

There we go…

Heh heh, too bad… You guys go with Hongo and chase down this Shocker top executive!
Got it… Let's go, Hongo, [HERO4]!!
"Don't hold it against me, [HERO2]. Just like you said… the coin's tails on both sides."
"Don't hold it against me, [HERO2]. Just like you said… the coin's heads on both sides."

…!?

That's Shocker for you. Arriving right on time, huh? All right, let's go…
Yeah…
What was that scream just now?
What the?
Damn… Is it Shocker!? Taki, I'm counting on you here!
Leave it to me! More importantly, I'm counting on you to save Yoshiko! That power plant looks suspicious.
Yeah…
…!? A Shocker cyborg?

Hoooowww…

Hayato Ichimonji! Now that you've come here, it's clear where Dr. Otaguro is. You people are hiding him, aren't you?

What if we are?

Hand over Yoshiko and get out of my sight! It's for your own good.

Don't get cocky!

That girl is a precious hostage. I'm not handing her over! Fool… Behold my power!
Waaaaagh…
Waaaaagh…

Hoooowww…

Now do you see! Kamen Rider is no match for me! Ha ha ha…
Hayato! Hayato!!
Ugh… th-they got me…
What about Yoshiko?
Ugh… Shocker has her… Ngh, I couldn't save her!
What!? You, screwing up???
He's a terrifying opponent…
I… don't even know how to apologize.
Yoshiko took my place… Yoshiko, who's done nothing wrong, all because I asked her to do that…

Hayato, what a disgrace!

How can you have the gall to come back here? Why? Why didn't you go after them? Why couldn't you bring Yoshiko back, even if it cost you your life?
Oyassan! Please, don't get so worked up… Hayato did everything he could.
That's right! Aren't you going a bit too far, no matter what?
Even Hayato can fail sometimes…

Quiet!

Hayato is not allowed to fail, not even once!

That's Hayato Ichimonji's mission!

And if he dies!?

Then it's all for nothing! Who's going to fight Shocker and the other organizations?

I'm here!

And you're here, and Takeshi too! [HERO2] and [HERO4] will fight just fine too! I'm sure they will!
Oyassan… Maybe I've been going easy on myself.
Someone who goes easy on himself could never put his life on the line!

Everyone, please stop. It's only because I'm here that you're having all this trouble…

I should never have come here for help after all.
Doctor, this time for sure… I'll bring Yoshiko back, even if it costs me my life.

It's surely too late now…

No doubt Yoshiko is suffering horribly in Shocker's hideout by now. And the X-Alpha Solution research materials, most likely…
Hello, Amigo… …!?
Hello? Hello? Yoshiko? It's you, Yoshiko, isn't it?
What!?

…!? That voice?

Hayato, he's asking for you.
For me? Who is it?
It's Colonel Zol.
What!?
Hello? Hello…

Is this Hayato Ichimonji? Listen well!

We of Shocker have indeed obtained the X-Alpha Solution research materials. I have no further use for this woman!

If you want her returned alive, come to Jigokudani at once!

One of our Shocker's top executives has come to Japan from the Swiss Branch… It's about time I settled things with you, or I'll lose face.

Zol… Colonel Zol!

Bring it on… Until then, don't lay a hand on Yoshiko!

Ha ha ha…

I am a man who keeps his promises. But I am the one who will win… so you needn't worry about that, need you? Ha ha ha…
I won't forgive you! Zol… Colonel Zol!
Hayato, what did Colonel Zol say?
He means to settle things with us. He told us to come to Jigokudani, and Yoshiko's there too…

Jigokudani?

That's it! Now I see it! What Shocker is plotting with Operation World Darkness!
What do you mean?

There's a power plant in Jigokudani. A million-volt output, supplying electricity to more than ten major cities!

Shocker means to build revived monsters with the X-Alpha Solution, destroy similar power plants all over the world one after another, and use the chaos to carry out world conquest!

The Shocker top executive who came to Japan brought a huge load of explosives from the Swiss Branch! [HERO2] and I blew up most of it, but I can't say we got it all!

Most likely, they'll blow up Yoshiko along with the power plant…
I see… That's just the kind of thing they'd come up with!

Hey, Hayato! Where are you going by yourself? Hayato!!

Takeshi! [HERO2], [HERO4]! Protect Hayato, protect that boy for me!

Oyassan…

All right, let's go! [HERO4]!
Agreed! If Mr. Hongo and Hayato are going, [HERO2], then it's our turn, right?
Ah, yeah…
Aren't you forgetting someone?
Huh? You're coming too, Mr. Taki? I hope you won't slow us down…
Wha? Why, [HERO4], you…
Just kidding! Joke, joke… A full-grown adult getting so flustered… How embarrassing, nyah!
Ha ha ha… Hey, Taki, [HERO4] got one over on you, eh?
All right… I'll go after this Shocker top executive!
Then I'll handle Yoshiko…
[HERO2]… What will you do?
What'll I do… How should we decide? Do I go with Mr. Hongo, or with Hayato?
Whichever you like…
Come on, Mr. Hongo… You're not going to use some coin with heads on both sides, are you?
Rescue Yoshiko and be the lone prince charming? That wouldn't be bad either, but come on, trust me…
Then, heads… Actually, maybe tails?

Here goes…

Heh heh, too bad… You guys go with Hayato and chase down this Shocker top executive!
